keywords.title: Keywords / Palavras-chave
keywords.description: Job titles or terms to search, e.g. 'analista de dados', 'vendedor', 'python'. Leave empty to list all open jobs.

maxItems.title: Max jobs
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to return across all keywords.

states.title: States (UF)
states.description: Two-letter state codes, e.g. SP, RJ, MG.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: City names, e.g. São Paulo, Curitiba (accents optional).

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Keep only jobs whose company name contains one of these terms.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs published in the last N days. Great for daily scheduled runs.
